## Limits of this run

- Offline bm25s over the same memories (Lucene BM25, English stop words, Snowball stems), not a served path; One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only.
- One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only.
- One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only. Served bm25 over the same seeded sample, on the same host in the same hour, for comparison with bm25-rerank-d20; the full-set bm25 row is the reference run.
- One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only. bm25's list reranked by ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 through candle on the CPU at depth 20 (the default became 10 after this run), with a cap of 8 and a 60 s deadline so no rerank was skipped; the host carried a load average of 9 to 29 from other work, and the LoCoMo run shared it with the NFCorpus run, so its latency is an upper bound (ADR-0053 d4, FR-88).
